text:
A submarine is in water of density 1.0×103
kg/m3. The submarine changes its depth. This causes
the pressure on it to change by 0.10MPa.
What is the change in depth of the submarine?
A
0.10m
B
10m
C
100m
D
1000m
subject: Physics
